papers.title: Motor Imagery Classification Using Hybrid Cross-Subject Class Mixup and Selective Attention
papers.reason: Human EEG-fNIRS motor imagery classification may offer generic multimodal signal-processing ideas, but it is not about executive function, cognitive impairment assessment, or human attention despite using an attention module.

papers.title: The role of prefrontal sharp wave ripple-like events in working memory and behavioral performance
papers.reason: The paper directly concerns prefrontal neural events linked to working memory and behavioral performance, making it highly relevant to neuroscience findings on executive function.

papers.title: Testing an accelerated transcranial magnetic stimulation protocol for methamphetamine use disorder — study protocol
papers.reason: The study targets DLPFC circuits implicated in cognitive control, but its core contribution is a clinical TMS feasibility protocol for methamphetamine use disorder rather than executive function modelling or assessment.

papers.title: Middle‐Aged and Older Parents' Cognitive Impairment and Adult Children's Proximity and Contact: Mobile‐App Based Assessment
papers.reason: The paper uses mobile digital biomarkers including keystroke, speech, and eye movement features to assess cognitive impairment, though its main focus is social contact patterns rather than executive function.
